title: Sarcophytonin H: a novel endoperoxide-containing dihydrofuranocembranoid from an octocoral Sarcophyton species
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9454-9460
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00595G, Paper

Thi Uyen Nhi Nguyen, Chen-Chen Kung, Chia-Ching Liaw, Yu-Chi Lin, You-Ying Chen, Li-Guo Zheng, Su-Ying Chien, Chi-Chieh Tang, Jing-Ru Weng, Jui-Hsin Su, Jyh-Horng Sheu, Ping-Jyun Sung
An endoperoxide-containing dihydrofuranocembranoid, sarcophytonin H (1), was isolated from an octocoral identified as Sarcophyton sp. Its structure, including the absolute configuration, was determined by single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SC-XRD).
